{{DISPLAYTITLE:P<sup>2</sup>-irreducible manifold}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''P<sup>2</sup>-irreducible manifold''' is a [[3-manifold]] that is [[irreducible manifold|irreducible]] and contains no [[2-sided]] <math>\mathbb RP^2</math> ([[real projective plane]]). An [[orientable manifold]] is P<sup>2</sup>-irreducible if and only if it is irreducible.<ref name="eom">{{cite encyclopedia|title=Encyclopaedia of Mathematics, Supplement III| volume=13|first=Michiel|last=Hazewinkel|author-link=Michiel Hazewinkel|publisher=Springer|year=2001|isbn=9781556080104|page=183|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=47YC2h295JUC&pg=PA183}}.</ref> Every non-orientable P<sup>2</sup>-irreducible manifold is a [[Haken manifold]].<ref>{{cite book|title=Geometry and Topology|first1=George M.|last1=Rassias|first2=George|last2=Stratopoulos|publisher=World Scientific|year=1989|isbn=9789971506780|page=33|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=YeOlzY1xCYIC&pg=PA33}}.</ref>
